comments: Tommy mentions after the Friday Night Connection that Andy Batten-Foster will be the guest host for the next two shows.
Tommy mentions after the Motörhead song that many people wrote in to praise the Scorched Earth session the previous week.
Tommy mentions at the end of the show that producer Tony Wilson was in Germany at the time recording Accept for future broadcast. That’s presumably the session first broadcast on 19th August, 1983.
